turns.q: Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
turns.replyTail:
Yes, they are handled quite differently!

Because all of our orders are final sale, we do not accept standard returns or exchanges for change of mind or fit issues.

However, if an item arrives damaged or defective, it is covered under our warranty policy. You can submit a warranty claim with photo proof so our team can review it and provide a replacement or store credit if approved. 🙂
